3: ## Global
4: Stack — backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2 async (asyncpg), Alembic, Pydantic v2, argon2-cffi, PyJWT, boto3 (or minio-py), pytest+httpx. DB: PostgreSQL. Storage: MinIO. Worker: same backend image, PG queue (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), ffmpeg/ffprobe.

7: ### Deployability (graded: clean Ubuntu, ONE command)
8: - `sudo ./install.sh`: installs Docker if missing, generates .env with random secrets if absent, `docker compose up -d --build`, migrations run in the api entrypoint, bucket auto-created, waits for health, seeds demo data (idempotent), prints URL + demo logins. Safe to re-run. No host deps except Docker.
9: - Works on plain HTTP / bare IP: cookie `Secure` flag is env-driven (COOKIE_SECURE, default false). No hardcoded hostnames.
10: - Windows dev machine: `.gitattributes` with `*.sh text eol=lf`; install.sh committed executable (`git update-index --chmod=+x`).
11: - Prod compose: no bind mounts, no reload. `docker-compose.dev.yml` override for dev. Frontend built in multi-stage Dockerfile, served by nginx. Only nginx publishes a port (80); db/minio not published. Healthchecks + depends_on conditions.
12: - Upload limit via env (default 500MB), nginx client_max_body_size matches.
13: - Media path: bucket private. Browser uploads (single presigned PUT) and plays via nginx `/storage/` → MinIO. Recommended trick: sign against the internal endpoint (minio:9000), return a relative `/storage/<path>?<query>` URL; nginx strips `/storage`, sets Host minio:9000, proxy_buffering/request_buffering off. Prove with a real file in M0. Fallback: stream through API with Range support.
14: - Seed generates demo videos with ffmpeg (lavfi testsrc), no binaries in repo.
15: 
16: ### Security (graded)
17: Server-side authz on every endpoint incl. media URL issuance; roles user/moderator/admin via dependency; argon2; short JWT + httpOnly SameSite refresh cookie; login rate limit; upload validation (ext + ffprobe + size); same-origin only (no open CORS); nginx security headers; no v-html with user content; pagination limits everywhere; no secrets in repo; hidden/private/unlisted never leak via feed, search, channel, comments or media.
